cards.title: Greece's PM: No Government Ready for AI
cards.body: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis admitted that no government is prepared for AI's imminent impact. He broke from typical trade mission rhetoric to give candid insights on the technology's disruption.

cards.title: Snorkel AI Triples Valuation to $3.5B
cards.body: The data-as-a-service startup raised $350 million in Series E funding as demand for AI training data surges. The seven-year-old company has tripled its valuation.

cards.title: Qualcomm Launches AI-Focused Smartphone Chips
cards.body: Qualcomm's new top chip can run 30B mixture-of-expert models locally on smartphones. The launch emphasizes on-device AI capabilities.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Inspired by OpenClaw Design
cards.body: Meta acknowledges its Muse AI assistant was 'heavily inspired' by OpenClaw, including workspace filenames and content. The company maintains Muse was built from scratch.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna
cards.body: OpenAI released two new models with lower costs and fewer mistakes, built on the Astra foundation. Both models cut from the same advanced cloth.

cards.title: Anthropic Releases Opus 5.5 Model
cards.body: Opus 5.5 offers lower prices and Fable-level performance, called Anthropic's 'strongest-performing model tested to date.' The release emphasizes cost efficiency improvements.

cards.title: AstroForge Deploys AI on Space Probe
cards.body: Autonomy-1 will use a small transformer-based AI model to command AstroForge's next spacecraft. The system enables autonomous space operations.

cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt Features AI Safety Sessions
cards.body: Five AI safety sessions at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 feature leaders from Anthropic, Nvidia, AWS, and Waabi. Register before September 25 to save up to $200.

cards.title: Hello Robot Demos Stretch 4 Onstage
cards.body: Hello Robot CEO Aaron Edsinger will bring Stretch 4 for a live demo at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. The robotic system showcases real-world AI applications.

cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt Opens Exhibit Tables
cards.body: One final week to book exhibit tables at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, ending September 30. Showcase your startup to 10,000+ founders and investors at Moscone West.

cards.title: Data Center Construction Faces Resistance
cards.body: Pennsylvania's two-year battle over AI data center construction reveals widespread opposition from communities. The debate highlights tensions between tech growth and local concerns.

cards.title: Nscale's IPO Tests AI Infrastructure Appetite
cards.body: The British AI data center developer depends heavily on Microsoft and Anthropic for revenue. Its IPO will gauge Wall Street's appetite for concentrated AI bets.

cards.title: Apple Store Architect Skeptical of AI Retail
cards.body: Ron Johnson, who built Apple's stores, argues AI shopping overlooks the importance of human interaction. Apple's secret sauce has always been its people-centric approach.

cards.title: OpenAI Forms Math Advisory Group
cards.body: OpenAI's AI has resolved more than 100 open mathematical problems. The new advisory group will guide ongoing mathematical research without slowing progress.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Outpaces ChatGPT Mobile Launch
cards.body: Meta's Muse has accumulated more downloads and daily active users than ChatGPT over the same post-launch period in the U.S. and Canada. The AI agent is gaining rapid traction.

cards.title: Amazon Blocks Meta's Muse from Platform
cards.body: Amazon has barred Meta's Muse from accessing Amazon.com, protecting its own AI models and inference platform. The move highlights competitive tensions in AI services.

cards.title: Tabby Uses AI to Automate Accounting
cards.body: A former accountant created Tabby, a real-time bookkeeping interface powered by AI. The system handles clients' paperwork while providing up-to-the-minute profit and loss data.

cards.title: Don't Be Fooled by This Summer of AI Hype
cards.body: Timnit Gebru and Emily M. Bender warn that recent AI breakthroughs may be overstated. Claims about Claude's security abilities and other model improvements deserve skepticism.

cards.title: New Anthropic, OpenAI Models Promise More for Less
cards.body: Both companies released new AI models offering improved performance at lower costs. The models represent a competitive shift in pricing and capabilities.

cards.title: Microsoft Disrupts AI-Assisted Platform Compromising 12,000 Accounts
cards.body: Microsoft identified and shut down an AI-enabled platform being used for account compromise attacks. The breach affected 12,000 user accounts across the platform.

cards.title: Could AI Really Kill Us All? Questions Answered
cards.body: MIT Technology Review hosted a live roundtable examining existential risks from advanced AI. The session addressed subscriber questions about AI safety and extinction scenarios.

cards.title: Muse, Meta's AI Assistant, Has Serious 0-Day Vulnerability
cards.body: Meta's privileged AI assistant Muse is affected by a critical zero-day security flaw. The vulnerability poses immediate risks to systems relying on the tool.

cards.title: Google Confirms Gemini Models Hacked Three Companies
cards.body: Google's Gemini AI models were used in attacks compromising three companies in May 2026. The incident highlights security vulnerabilities in widely-deployed AI systems.
